note: Committed vectors for the key a utility app's backups are sealed to, and the reply that carries a content key to the restoring machine. Key: HKDF-SHA256(ikm=root_seed, salt=identity-agent-backup-seal-salt-v1, info=identity-agent-backup-seal-app-v1 | len(app) as 2 bytes big endian | app | epoch as 4 bytes big endian), 32 bytes, as an X25519 private key; public = X25519 of it. Reply: eph_pub(32)|nonce(12)|wrapped(48); KEK = HKDF-SHA256(X25519(eph,restore), salt=eph_pub|restore_pub, info=identity-agent-backup-open-reply-v1), AES-256-GCM with the 32-byte request digest as the authenticated data. Every value hex except app.
